en: Black‑and‑white image of a large Gothic church with two very tall, ornate twin towers featuring open tracery, pinnacles, and pointed arches. In front is a polygonal apse with a steep roof and rose window. The foreground shows a cobblestone square with a low stone wall, a small group of people, and temporary wooden structures around the church base. Surrounding buildings have steep roofs and historic European architecture. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image.
